name: The Feral Mongoose Rumble
format_rules: EMOM — Every Minute On the Minute, 20 min. Start a timer. At the start of each minute do the next move, then rest until the minute is up. Cycle through the 2 moves 10 times. Can't finish in the minute? Drop the reps a bit.
twist: TEMPO MODE: take 3 full seconds to lower on every rep.

warmup.cue: Hands on hips, draw big circles each way.
Interlace fingers, roll wrists in circles.

main.cue: Quick tiny steps on the balls of your feet.
From side plank, dip hip toward floor and lift back up.

cooldown.cue: Fold forward, soft knees, let your head hang.
Elbow up, hand down your back, gently press elbow.
Half-kneel, tuck pelvis, lean forward slightly.
